utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: You bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm not convinced it's even happening. You sure this repair drive is on?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it's this Saturday at the community center. I saw the flyer myself.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I'm worried about scheduling — if we all show up at different times, nothing will get done efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Don't worry, we can set up specific time slots so everything runs smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I'm still worried about who's doing what — we need clear assignments.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara! I'm so glad you stopped by. I wanted to see if you're free to help with the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm definitely free on Saturday! I was planning to help out—just haven't signed the sheet yet. Did you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, thank you! Tools would be great if you have any extra, but we'll have plenty on hand too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you tell me who's in charge of organizing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I'm not entirely sure who's in charge. I think Leo or Uli might know more about that.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, do you know when the repair drive is happening then?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's tough. Hope you can track down what you need soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, but the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM if you want to come help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, I'll try to stop by!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's been tough finding the right bolts for the swings.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, tell me about it! I heard the repair drive is finally happening—maybe we can get those swings fixed up proper.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I hope so. It's just been hard to source the right parts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm trying to learn more about it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard it's this Saturday at 10 AM. I like to know the schedule ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks! Do you know where it's happening or what kind of tasks they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, 10 to 4 on Saturday. I'll stop by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Bo! Hope to see you there. I'll have my truck loaded with tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Gus. I'll bring my own hammer just in case.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So the one from the community center—do you remember the proposed days and times?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I think it's Saturday at 9 AM, right? I'll be there a bit late though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday at 9 AM? Let me confirm with the others. What time do you think you'll arrive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Opal, I'm organizing a repair drive and we're really short on lumber. Do you happen to have any spare boards?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don't have any spare lumber myself, but I recall the old Henderson house on Maple Street had a pile out back last week. Might be worth checking there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's a great lead! I'll swing by the Henderson place tomorrow and see what's there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll snap a pic and text it to you later this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, but I'll probably forget I even asked for it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries, I'll remind you when I send it!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm actually helping Cleo sort through donated parts and tools for it!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Sam! Let me know if you need me to round up more folks to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tess, I'm so glad you stopped by! We're really short on lumber for the repair drive. Do you happen to have any spare boards?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I might have a few old fence planks out back! Let me check, and if not, I bet the folks at the hardware store could donate some.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be amazing, Tess! Even a few planks would help a ton. The hardware store idea is great too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let me know if I can help you track down any of those parts, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the list of houses and parts needed, Ira. Want to compare notes?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, Opal, let's sit down and go over what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who's running the repair drive this time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, but I think I heard it's a handful of the longtime residents planning it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you name any of them?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm still trying to figure out the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm helping out! I've got my truck loaded with tools from my shed, ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's great! Do you know what time we're supposed to start? I'm still trying to get a clear schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at 9 AM at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to make it, but I might be a little late. Got some personal things to handle first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem, just come when you can! Every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, have you checked the sign-up sheet for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, Faye. Do you know what time we're starting? I heard 10 AM, but I'd like to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think they said 10 AM on the flyer, but the sign-up sheet should have the exact details—I can snap a picture of it for you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I remember hearing about that... wait, what is it again?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's a community event where we fix broken items together this Saturday. Want to join in?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, right! I think I have a toaster that's been acting up. Should I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Pia, is it the same repair drive they mentioned at the community center last week?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that's the one. But I'm still worried about how we're going to get everything coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I hear your concern. Maybe we can start by listing what needs to be repaired and who's available to help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm planning to come, but I'll probably be a bit late. Is that okay?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, no problem. Later's fine.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Cool, thanks for understanding. I'll be there as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about that... somewhere. Sorry, I misplaced it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Noah! It's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community garden. We'll be fixing up tools and bikes. Want to come?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 10? Got it. I'll try to remember... I'll put it on my fridge this time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks Faye, a photo of the sign-up sheet would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your broken items Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, Leo. I'll be there with my toaster early Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so there are flyers. But I'll still need to see actual folks showing up with broken toasters before I'm convinced.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I get it, Kira! But you'd be surprised how many people just need a little nudge. The flyers will help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, Rosa. I’ll believe it when I see a pile of broken clocks and a soldering iron in action.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
